title: feat(nm2holxzrd): neighbor-read of xz-plane cyclic-frame holonomy at t+1 on two-axis opposite seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: The band's only xz-plane (normal e_2) member: squares P-Q-R-S at y=0 and y=1 on 2A. Both fail from split fail at Q,Q2 (m=−e_3, empty cyclic prev). Reader census: the xz plane carries 0 holding squares in 2A/3F/SL and 1 in 3N, against 3-5 in yz and 2-4 in xy — the readout is strongly plane-anisotropic and this is the only member that probes the third plane.
